findings.F-5: the late completion ends its own episode (the frame's ownership-moved branch); the off-clock cancellation that follows returns early at Idle, so the fixture pins cancellation as idempotent rather than as a second release
findings.F-6: the operation identity is stamped on more than one path (the admitted build begin and the freeze path), so removing the build-begin stamp alone fails no test — mutation MR-A recorded as a non-red-proof, and the fixture's identity assertion is therefore not a claim about that one line
findings.F-7: a fixture that forces a build to begin through the retry path and then rewinds the clock kills the episode before the lane can serve it (the drive must continue monotonically after the begin loop)
findings.F-8: the frame projects forward between the request and the build it begins, so a build's coverage interval is the frame's projection at build time, not the request's interval
